title: The Flying Dutchman Legend
hook: Why does a ghost ship still haunt sailors today?
headline: Eternal Ship Caught on Horizon

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In the 1660s, a Dutch captain vanished near the Cape.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Sailors reported a burning hull off the coast of England.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: A crew sighted a phantom vessel near the Norwegian fjords.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Modern radar sometimes picks up an unexplained echo where the legend persists.

end.line: Could the Dutchman's curse still roam the seas?

description: Explore the centuries-old sightings of the ghost ship known as the Flying Dutchman.

facts.claim: Captain Van der Decken allegedly disappeared in 1661 near the Cape of Good Hope.
A report from 1738 describes a burning hull seen off England's coast.
In 1795, Norwegian sailors recorded a phantom vessel near their fjords.
Modern radar occasionally registers an unexplained echo in the North Sea.
